wiki_only_topics.topic: Genetic sections and geographic distribution of Buxus species
wiki_only_topics.quote_wikipedia: The genus splits into three genetically distinct sections, each section in a different region, with the Eurasian species in one section, the African (except northwest Africa) and Madagascan species in the second, and the American species in the third.
The genomes of Buxus austro-yunnanensis and Buxus sinica have been sequenced.

wiki_only_topics.topic: Box tree moth damage in Britain and Europe
wiki_only_topics.quote_wikipedia: In Britain and mainland Europe, box is subject to damage from caterpillars of Cydalima perspectalis which can devastate a box hedge within a short time.

wiki_only_topics.topic: Use of boxwood for chess pieces and woodblock printing
wiki_only_topics.quote_wikipedia: Owing to the relatively high density of the wood, boxwood is often used for chess pieces; unstained boxwood for the white pieces, and stained (' ebonized ') boxwood for the black pieces in lieu of ebony.
